scope: 144 P1 observations only; separate Wave 01's 12 selected summaries were not deduplicated into this number.
release_rules: None of the 42 drafts automatically corresponds to a unique canonical new custom.
For every draft, reconcile existing Calendar, Saints, Explore, Pray and Customs Atlas IDs, then check staged PRs #1512 and #1516.
Merged histories or source-observations never imply duplicated user content.
A source match from 1964 Roman Ritual translation does not prove its 1962 permissions or mandatory parish application.
Partial and unmatched holds are retained rather than labelled disproved or automatically published.
Respect copyright by publishing original summaries only.
